methodology.Revenue: The 5% of swap fees burned as RUNE (value to all RUNE holders) plus protocol-kept income (outbound fees net of the gas reimbursed to nodes, slashing fees, developer fund and marketing fund). ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees: 100% of the 1% platform fees are sent to lockin's house fee wallets on TON, Solana and BNB Chain.

methodology.Fees: $KINS paid by players: full paid-spinner payments (50% burned, 50% to treasury) plus the 5% treasury fee on marketplace gold-for-$KINS sales.
methodology.Revenue: All fees accrue to the protocol side: burned $KINS plus $KINS retained by treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 50% of every paid spinner payment is burned, reducing $KINS supply.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: $KINS retained by treasury (50% of spins and 5% of marketplace sales).

Fees.Paid Spinner: Treasury half of paid spinner payments.
Fees.Spinner Burn: Burned half of paid spinner payments.
Fees.Marketplace Token Sales: 5% treasury fee on marketplace gold-for-$KINS sales.

Revenue.Paid Spinner: Treasury half of paid spinner payments.
Revenue.Spinner Burn: Burned half of paid spinner payments.
Revenue.Marketplace Token Sales: 5% treasury fee on marketplace gold-for-$KINS sales.

ProtocolRevenue.Paid Spinner: Treasury half of paid spinner payments.
ProtocolRevenue.Marketplace Token Sales: 5% treasury fee on marketplace gold-for-$KINS sales.

HoldersRevenue.Spinner Burn: Burned half of paid spinner payments.

methodology.Fees: Includes Pump.fun creator/partner fee shares earned on every coin launched using the protocol and $ANSEM tokens burned to unlock launch tiers.
methodology.Revenue: Captured pump.fun fee shares and platform payments plus $ANSEM tier burns.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Captured pump.fun fee shares and platform payments kept by the Ansem.io treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: $ANSEM permanently burned for Gold/Diamond launch tiers, accruing to remaining $ANSEM holders.

Fees.Creator Fees: Pump.fun creator/partner fee shares on Ansem-launched coins, captured by the platform's launch wallets (Ansem is each coin's on-chain creator) and swept to the treasury.
Fees.ANSEM Tier Burns: $ANSEM permanently burned to unlock Gold and Diamond launch tiers.

Revenue.Creator Fees: Captured pump.fun fee shares and platform payments, kept by the treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Creator Fees: Captured pump.fun fee shares and platform payments, kept by the treasury.

methodology.Fees: Successful mainnet round-settlement fees calculated from the BidGrid ResetEvent allocation fields. User deposits, payouts and premine transfers are not counted as fees.
methodology.Revenue: Gross profit from BidGrid round fees after excluding the jackpot amount paid back to winning miners.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The 1.5% protocol fee from each round's total deployed SOL, retained as the protocol treasury allocation.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Round-fee allocations assigned to BDGR buybacks, BDGR staking rewards and the Burn Pot.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The jackpot allocation paid back to winning miners from the non-winning-tile fee.

Fees.Mining Fees: Total native-SOL round fees calculated from successful BidGrid ResetEvent allocations.

Revenue.Mining Fees Revenue: Native-SOL round fees retained as gross profit after the jackpot payout allocation.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Revenue: The 1.5% protocol fee from each round's total deployed SOL, retained as the protocol treasury allocation.

SupplySideRevenue.Mining Fees to Jackpot: 4% of losing-tile deployment value allocated to the SOL jackpot paid to winning miners.

HoldersRevenue.Mining Fees to $BDGR Buyback: 4% of the non-winning-tile fee allocated to BDGR buybacks.
HoldersRevenue.Mining Fees to $BDGR Stakers: 2% of the non-winning-tile fee allocated to eligible BDGR stakers.
HoldersRevenue.Mining Fees to Burn Pot: 0.5% of the non-winning-tile fee assigned to the Burn Pot for instant refined BDGR burns for SOL.
